summary: Supplier invoice from BrightGrid Ltd. placed on manual hold due to missing VAT breakdown
description:
Issue summary: AP intake placed invoice INV-2026-0098 (BrightGrid Ltd.) on manual hold. The PDF shows a single total that includes VAT but does not provide a VAT line or VAT registration number. NetSuite validation rules require an explicit VAT amount for UK invoices to pass automated validation.

Impact: Payment run for this vendor (next scheduled run 2026-03-10) is blocked; supplier has escalated via Vendor Ops and flagged as 'urgent' due to payroll cycle dependency. This affects cashflow to one critical third-party contractor in UK.

Environment: NetSuite AP ingestion pipeline (prod), vendor-email gateway, invoice-parsers service. Region: eu-west (UK).
impact: Single vendor payment delayed; manual AP workload increased. Potential vendor escalation to Legal if missed payroll. One payment (~GBP 23,450) at risk in the 2026-03-10 run.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Retrieve invoice PDF attached to vendor email (INV-2026-0098).
2) Upload to AP ingestion endpoint (used during normal email processing).
3) Observe NetSuite validation status -> 'manual hold' with reason 'missing VAT breakdown / VAT reg not provided'.
4) Check invoice-parsers service logs for parsing output - VAT field empty.
logs:
invoice-parsers: parse_invoice(id=INV-2026-0098) -> parsed_total=23450.00 GBP, parsed_vat=null, vat_reg_number=null
netSuite-validate: validation failed for invoice INV-2026-0098 -> rule VAT_BREAKDOWN_REQUIRED triggered
AP-workflow: manual_hold created by ingest-worker-3 at 2026-03-05T09:42:12Z
Vendor email headers: from: accounts@brightgrid.co.uk; subject: Invoice INV-2026-0098
Related Slack thread: #finance-helpdesk thread ts 2026-03-05T10:03Z
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: vendor changed invoice template to include VAT in grand total but omitted a VAT line and VAT reg number. Confirmed by manual review of PDF.
Further evidence: invoice-parsers regex for VAT line did not match; parsing fallback recorded 'total_including_tax' without breakdown.
NetSuite currently enforces VAT_BREAKDOWN_REQUIRED for country=GB when total > 1000 GBP. This rule prevented auto-accept.
Checked vendor master data: BrightGrid Ltd. has vendor record with VAT registration on file (GB999888777), but ingestion pipeline did not attach VAT reg to parsed invoice due to missing VAT line.
Actionable hypothesis: modify invoice-parsers to fallback to vendor master VAT reg when VAT line missing OR adjust validator to accept vendor_reg present and a note in PDF stating VAT included in total.
comments: Leila Martin (reporter) - 2026-03-05: Vendor Ops escalated - vendor says they need funds by next payroll. Please prioritise validation so we can include in 2026-03-10 payment run.
Omar Singh (assignee) - 2026-03-05: Confirmed invoice lacks a VAT line. Pulling parsed artifacts and contacting AP team. Will attempt manual release if tax confirms amount.

Tax (Jane Alvarez) - 2026-03-06: We can accept a manual VAT calculation for this occurrence. Need documented justification and vendor to provide corrected invoice within 30 days. Approve manual release for one-off payment.
AP Ops (Marco Chen) - 2026-03-06: Per tax approval, we can process a one-time manual journal to account for VAT. Requesting quoted VAT amount from Omar to create journal entry before payment run.

Omar Singh - 2026-03-07: Extracted line-item totals from PDF and estimated VAT = 3,908.33 GBP (assumes 20%). Preparing manual journal and GL code mapping. Also opened a task with infra to change parser fallback (see GH PR below).
Vendor Ops (Sophie Grant) - 2026-03-07: Notified BrightGrid; they will reissue corrected invoice but cannot guarantee before 2026-03-10. They asked us to proceed with manual release if acceptable.
Omar Singh - 2026-03-08: Manual release executed and payment scheduled for 2026-03-10. Created follow-up INT task to update parser and vendor onboarding checklist.
resolution: Manual release performed with Tax sign-off. AP created manual VAT journal to record VAT=3,908.33 GBP against GL 2100. BrightGrid requested to resend corrected invoice within 30 days. Follow-up actions: (1) implement parser fallback to vendor master VAT reg and VAT-from-total estimation (PR #246), (2) update vendor onboarding checklist to include template check, (3) add an alert to AP ingestion pipeline for invoices with VAT implied but not explicit.
